name: Under the Nails, Mass
body:
School necromancy [pain]; Level bloodlord 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as under the nails except it affects multiple creatures and the maximum damage is increased to 10d4.
